summary: Israeli Defense Minister Katz stated Israel's military campaign is not over, vowing to defeat Iran and continue operations in Gaza, Lebanon, and the West Bank. Satellite imagery shows Iran rapidly rebuilding the Talegan 2 facility at Parchin after Israeli strikes. A US report says Iran shot down at least two MQ-1 drones and lost 24 MQ-9 Reapers since the war began.
key_points: Israeli Defense Minister Katz said Israel will defeat and overthrow the Iranian government, and continue operations against Hamas and Hezbollah. (Source: @VahidOnline/78422)
Satellite imagery from September 13 shows Iran rebuilding the Talegan 2 facility at Parchin, with construction activity ongoing since June 2026. (Source: @asafroz/53537)
CBS News reports Iranian forces shot down at least two US MQ-1 drones in recent days, and at least 24 MQ-9 Reapers worth $720 million have been lost. (Source: @VahidOnline/78422)
An Italian Eurofighter was hit at King Fahd Air Base in Taif, Saudi Arabia, with no personnel injured. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7208)
A Houthi military statement said Saudi 'criminal attempts' in Sanaa were foiled and will not pass without a response. (Source: @naya_foriraq/90890)
Trump said the US is talking to the Houthis and that the Houthis also want a deal. (Source: @naya_foriraq/90894)
Israeli forces threw sound bombs toward Lebanese army soldiers at a new point near Deir Mimas. (Source: @redlinkleb/43610)

sections.executive_summary: Israeli Defense Minister Katz said Israel's military campaign is not over, vowing to defeat Iran and continue operations in Gaza, Lebanon, and the West Bank. Satellite imagery shows Iran rapidly rebuilding the Talegan 2 facility at Parchin after Israeli strikes. A US report says Iran shot down at least two MQ-1 drones and lost 24 MQ-9 Reapers since the war began.

points: Satellite imagery from September 13 shows Iran rapidly rebuilding the Talegan 2 facility at Parchin military complex, which was struck by Israel in October 2024 and March 2026. (Source: @asafroz/53537)

Iran has placed a cover sheet over the destroyed underground facility, hiding reconstruction work, with extensive construction activity including engineering vehicles, dump trucks, bulldozers, concrete pumps, mixers, and cranes. (Source: @asafroz/53537)
Repair work began in June 2026; Iran repaired and sealed with concrete the penetration holes caused by several bunker-buster bombs. (Source: @asafroz/53537)

Iran has built a new reinforced concrete pad on the right side of the facility, and the left-side pad is complete, expected to provide additional protection against blast from air attack. (Source: @asafroz/53537)
CBS News reports Iranian forces shot down at least two US MQ-1 drones in recent days, though US officials did not specify where or which MQ-1 model. (Source: @VahidOnline/78422)

The US State Department said an Iranian delegation will be allowed to attend the UN General Assembly next week, subject to movement restrictions and a ban on luxury purchases. (Source: @asafroz/53532)

Israeli Defense Minister Katz said Israel's military campaign is not over and it has 'important goals' against Iran and other fronts, vowing to act with military power and political wisdom. (Source: @VahidOnline/78422)

Katz said Israel's policy in Gaza, Lebanon, and the northern West Bank focuses on stripping jihadist groups of territory, infrastructure, commanders, and rearmament capabilities. (Source: @VahidOnline/78422)
Katz said Israel targeted commanders of the 'Palestinian Corps' in Iran and will not allow Iran or any other party to rearm Hamas. (Source: @VahidOnline/78422)

Prime Minister Netanyahu said Israel has completed most of its mission against Iran and its allied groups, but the mission is not finished, and Israel will destroy Hamas and 'overthrow' the Iranian government. (Source: @VahidOnline/78422)
Netanyahu said Iran and its allies' ability to harm Israel has been severely weakened, and Israel will continue operations against Hezbollah. (Source: @VahidOnline/78422)
An 18-year-old was killed in a hit-and-run in Hadera and a 30-year-old was killed in a violent incident in Ashkelon; both are criminal, not conflict-related. (Source: @yediotnews25/135099)
Israeli Defense Minister Katz said Israel's policy in Gaza focuses on stripping jihadist groups of territory, infrastructure, commanders, and rearmament capabilities. (Source: @VahidOnline/78422)
Katz said Israel will not allow Iran or any other party to rearm Hamas, and will continue operations to prevent a repeat of October 7. (Source: @VahidOnline/78422)
Katz addressed Turkish President Erdogan, saying if he wants to help his 'like-minded people' in Gaza, he can invite them to Antalya, but 'will not set foot in Gaza.' (Source: @VahidOnline/78422)
Balad party chairman Sami Abu Shahada asked the Central Elections Committee not to disqualify him despite an article praising the achievements of the 'massacre.' (Source: @amitsegal/65002)
The Israeli army threw sound bombs toward Lebanese army soldiers at a newly established point on the outskirts of Deir Mimas. (Source: @redlinkleb/43610)
Israeli Defense Minister Katz said Israel will continue its operations against Hezbollah. (Source: @VahidOnline/78422)
Protests and road closures occurred in front of a private generator in Kirkuk governorate due to the owner's refusal to operate it. (Source: @naya_foriraq/90889)
The Italian defence ministry confirmed an Italian Eurofighter was hit at King Fahd Air Base in Taif, Saudi Arabia; no personnel were involved or injured. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7208)
Bloomberg reports Saudi Arabia will supply no crude oil to European refiners next month after a drone attack forced the shutdown of its key East-West pipeline. (Source: @shin_persian/10156)
A Houthi military spokesman said Saudi 'criminal attempts' in Sanaa were foiled and will not pass without a response. (Source: @naya_foriraq/90890)
Trump said the US is talking to the Houthis and the Houthis also want a deal. (Source: @naya_foriraq/90894)
A huge rally was held in Yemen's Saada in support of the country's armed forces. (Source: @presstv/207317)

sections.threat_assessment: The most immediate threat is the ongoing Israel-Iran confrontation, with Israel vowing to overthrow the Iranian government and Iran rebuilding its Parchin facility after Israeli strikes. The Houthi front remains active, with Saudi Arabia facing drone attacks on critical infrastructure and the US engaging in direct talks with the Houthis. The incident involving an Italian Eurofighter in Saudi Arabia highlights the risk of escalation to Gulf states, while the Israeli sound bomb incident against Lebanese army soldiers risks a new front with Lebanon.
sections.regional_response: The US is allowing an Iranian delegation to attend the UN General Assembly under restrictions, while also reporting Iranian drone shootdowns. Saudi Arabia is dealing with the aftermath of a drone attack on its East-West pipeline, cutting oil supplies to Europe. The Houthis are holding rallies in support of their armed forces and threatening retaliation against Saudi 'criminal attempts.'
sections.intelligence_notes: Satellite imagery confirms Iran is rapidly rebuilding the Talegan 2 facility at Parchin, using concrete pads and cover sheets to protect against air attack. The loss of 24 MQ-9 Reapers and one MQ-4C Triton indicates significant US attrition in the region. The Italian Eurofighter hit at Taif air base suggests a potential air defense incident or drone attack, though details remain unclear.
